newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin meets Belarus leader in sanatorium.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin meets Belarus leader in sanatorium.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin had talks with Belarussian leader Alexander Lukashenko on Wednesday, the Kremlin press service said.
The meeting took place in the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow where Yeltsin, 65, is preparing for an operation to improve blood supply to his heart.

The press service said the two men had agreed on the need to maintain the pace of integration between their two countries under an agreement reached in April to forge a loose alliance between the two former Soviet republics.
Further details of the meeting between Yeltsin and Lukashenko, who was also scheduled to meet Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, were expected to be released later.

Sergei Mironov, the head of the Kremlin medical centre, was quoted by Interfax news agency as saying on Wednesday that Yeltsin's surgery would take place in the middle of November. He dismissed speculation that the operation might be delayed.
